title: Extending Compulsory Education to GCE "O" or "N" Levels
what_it_is: Extending Compulsory Education to GCE "O" or "N" Levels

sections.label: Compulsory Education Act deliberation
sections.summary: The committee deliberated making secondary education compulsory, and Parliament discussed this when the Compulsory Education Act was introduced; legislating it does not ensure full enrolment or solve non-attendance.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: The committee had also deliberated whether secondary education should be made compulsory, and Parliament discussed this when the Compulsory Education Act was introduced.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Legislating Compulsory Education does not ensure full enrolment in schools or solve the root problems of non-attendance, as these are often complex and multifaceted in nature.

sections.label: Near-universal secondary education achieved
sections.summary: Collective efforts achieved near-universal secondary education, with less than 1% of each Primary 1 cohort not completing it, so extending compulsory education is unlikely to help further.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: With these collective efforts, Singapore has achieved near-universal secondary education.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Today, as it stands, less than 1% of each Primary 1 cohort does not complete secondary education.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: A legislative extension of compulsory education is unlikely to be effective in reducing this any further.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: To prepare our youths for future challenges, MOE will continue to support our children in their education at every stage by providing a quality education and meeting their needs.
